subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should this remain the separate canonical investigation for persistent post-restart Telegram forum-topic black holes, or should maintainers fold it into the guarded-lane timeout work only after same-root proof exists?
rationale: The source and tests prove an overlapping guarded-lane timeout path, but the field reports add durable per-topic suppression after full restarts and session deletion, so the recovery boundary and proof bar need maintainer intent before automation should patch it.

options.title: Keep Separate Persistent Topic Investigation
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical durable-state investigation and require live or restart-replay proof before closure.

options.title: Fold After Same-Root Proof
options.body: Fold it into the guarded-lane timeout issue only if maintainers confirm the same root cause explains the post-restart forum-topic behavior.

options.title: Close After Future Fix Proof
options.body: Close later only when a merged fix proves fresh non-reply forum-topic inbound messages recover after stuck-session recovery and restart.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Persistent Topic Investigation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical durable-state investigation and require live or restart-replay proof before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior Telegram isolated-ingress and replay recovery work is the strongest owner trail for the lane, reply-fence, and restart semantics.
